usage: check_design.py [-h] [--forbidden-term FORBIDDEN_TERM]
                       [--max-lines MAX_LINES] [--index INDEX]
                       [--manifest MANIFEST]
                       [root]

Check design directories and render their deterministic Markdown index.

positional arguments:
  root

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --forbidden-term FORBIDDEN_TERM
  --max-lines MAX_LINES
                        README line limit; 0 disables it
  --index INDEX         index output, relative to root
  --manifest MANIFEST   declared sources for the index writer
